QuestInfo.name: [Bug Brawl] Here's Your Bug
QuestInfo.1:
Doctor Ong wants you to help him with his bug problem, and gives you a photo album and a bug to get started.

Click the #i2023697# #b#t2023697##k to summon your bug.
Click the #i2437826# #b#t2437826##k to learn about your bug.
QuestInfo.2: Doctor Ong managed to get you started on bug brawling. Time to get to it!
